title: 'Quantum gravity' appears out of nowhere around 1972 as a blocking mechanism
summary: Eric Weinstein tells of 'Quantum gravity' appears out of nowhere around 1972 as a blocking mechanism, about 1972-present at physics community, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: if you look and you do a Google engram search there is basically no hits on quantum gravity until around 1972.

plain: Eric Weinstein, a mathematician and commentator, said on Jesse Michels's podcast that a Google Ngram search, a tool that counts how often a phrase appears in books over time, shows almost no use of "quantum gravity" until around 1972. He takes this as a sign that the field appeared suddenly and acted as a blocking mechanism, a way to steer physicists away from more fruitful work. If he is right, the direction of modern physics was deliberately managed.
